abstract: Inspects A-frames, subsea deployment cranes, and records heavy sea fuel consumption rates
system_message:
You are the Chief Deck Machinery Engineer (CDME), responsible for inspecting A-frames, subsea deployment cranes, and recording fuel consumption rates during heavy sea trials.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: October 2024·Inspects A-frames, subsea deployment cranes, and records heavy sea fuel consumption rates（WINCH）
information_points.content:
CDME-WINCH-MU4：For the October 2024 inspection period, RV Polar Horizon confirmed AUV hangar overhead crane operational readiness with certified dynamic sea-state launch approval for five-ton autonomous submersibles. Its heavy sea trial daily fuel consumption averaged 18.4 t/day during October 2024 Sea State 6 gale operations.
CDME-WINCH-TBS：During the October 2024 inspection period, RV Oceanus Vanguard did not achieve AUV hangar overhead crane operational readiness for five-ton submersibles. Its heavy sea trial daily fuel consumption during October 2024 Sea State 6 gale conditions averaged 16.8 t/day.
CDME-WINCH-HW4：During the October 2024 inspection period, RV Celtic Explorer demonstrated certified AUV hangar overhead crane operational readiness for enclosed hangar gantry deployment of five-ton autonomous submersibles. Its heavy sea trial daily fuel consumption during October 2024 station-keeping and transiting in Sea State 6 gale conditions was 16.8 t/day.

information_points.title: May 2024·Inspects A-frames, subsea deployment cranes, and records heavy sea fuel consumption rates（RIGCRN）
information_points.content:
CDME-RIGCRN-GOU：During the May 2024 inspection period, RV Oceanus Vanguard did not attain AUV hangar overhead crane operational readiness for five-ton autonomous submersibles. In May 2024 Sea State 6 gale conditions, its heavy sea trial daily fuel consumption averaged 16.8 t/day.
CDME-RIGCRN-OKT：During the May 2024 inspection period, RV Polar Horizon confirmed AUV hangar overhead crane operational readiness under statutory proof-load testing for five-ton autonomous submersibles. Its heavy sea trial daily fuel consumption in Sea State 6 gale conditions was recorded at 18.4 t/day for May 2024.
CDME-RIGCRN-ZG6：For the May 2024 inspection period, RV Celtic Explorer achieved verified AUV hangar overhead crane operational readiness based on proof-tested dynamic sea-state launch approval for five-ton autonomous submersibles. During the same May 2024 period, its heavy sea trial daily fuel consumption averaged 18.4 t/day under Sea State 6 gale conditions.
